findings.summary: The right-triangle formulas retained English side labels in the Indonesian presentation.
evidence: The explanatory paragraph used sisi berlawanan, sisi berdekatan, and sisi miring while the formulas displayed opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Localized all three formulas with the established Indonesian side terminology.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas retained English side labels in the Indonesian presentation.
evidence: The formulas displayed opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse in an otherwise Indonesian section.
findings.resolution: Localized all three inverse formulas with the established Indonesian side terminology.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example used shortened side labels instead of the terms used in the surrounding Indonesian explanation.
evidence: The example labels were berlawanan and berdekatan while the section consistently described the sides as sisi berlawanan and sisi berdekatan.
findings.resolution: Expanded both example labels to sisi berlawanan and sisi berdekatan.
